**EL-BEAM-1 Light mode and high beam**

The front lamps shall follow the driver's light-mode selection within 200 ms, from any previous selection:

| Light mode | Daylight running lamps | Low beam |
|---|---|---|
| Off | off | off |
| DaylightRunningLight | on | off |
| LowBeam | dimmed to position level | on |

Both sides shall always be lit alike.

High beam shall be lit on both sides while the driver requests it, and the cluster high-beam telltale shall be lit whenever high beam is requested.

description: Top-level requirement on ExteriorLightingDesign for the beam functions.

Status accepted, not verified: the breakdown made an assumption on the light-mode input explicit (EL-BEAM-1.1), and checking it found that the Logitech G29 input mapping breaks it. See EL_Beam_Mode_Review.md.
